findings.evidence: dom-1440.json meta viewport is 'width=1440'; tile 375-00 renders the full desktop layout scaled down, so text is ~4x smaller on a phone and the sweep's ROB-003 overflow follows from it.
findings.after: <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> plus a single-column layout below ~768px

findings.evidence: focus/06-on.png: the focused 'Start Free Trial' shows no visible ring; focus.json records the UA default 'auto 1px rgb(115,115,115)' with no offset, which disappears against the #1a1a1a fill. Sweep's focus_ring did not flag it.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.7 Focus Visible and 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (ring vs adjacent colours 3:1).

findings.where: nav links 'Product', 'Pricing', 'Docs', 'Blog', 'Sign In'; buttons 'Watch Demo', 'Get Started'
findings.evidence: focus.json: every nav link has href '#'; 'Watch Demo' is a <button> with no dialog or target. Links that go nowhere fail their stated purpose.
findings.after: Real hrefs (/pricing, /docs ...) or remove the items until the pages exist

findings.evidence: No <main>, no <header> (landmarks main:0); the hero and dashboard mock are bare divs; the first focusable is 'Product', not a skip link. The decorative mock's KPI text (e.g. 'REVENUE', 'AI Insight: Revenue Acceleration') is read as page content.
findings.after: Wrap the hero in <main>; mark the mock aria-hidden="true" or give it role="img" with aria-label="Example dashboard"

findings.evidence: The area chart svg has no name or role; it carries the only trend data in the mock.
findings.after: aria-hidden="true" if decorative, else role="img" aria-label describing the trend

strengths: Heading text is large and dark (#1a1a1a on #fafaf8); primary buttons meet contrast.
not_investigated: Sweep contrast hits on #777/#888/#aaa/#bbb greys verified visually in tile 1440-00 (stat labels, sub-line and mock labels are visibly faint): agreed, not repeated.
